🎓 Welcome to Maharuk University 💙
This game is an university life simulation game where players can be student, teacher, officer, etc.

🏙This game simulates the university environment. There are a lot of careers you would like to be. In the university, there are a soccer field, cafeteria, musical room, science room, library and others. Moreover, there are a lot of outfits or uniforms that you can change too. 

Earn moneys from taking a job or AFK!
SHIFT for sprint
RolePlay and save moneys to buy cool stuff!

🙏Enjoy playing the game.
